verdict: Ads have been paused since Sep 17; restoring spend is the immediate priority.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 17 — the 54 leads and $892.64 in spend this period are entirely from the first half of the window, with no money working for the last 17 days. Google Ads spent $222.79 over the full 28 days and produced zero leads before the pause, so that budget is being redirected rather than simply resumed. Your Google Business Profile has stayed active in the meantime, with direction requests up sharply this week, showing local visibility is holding on its own. Spend will be restored with a revised Google Ads approach, and several infrastructure pieces — including conversion tracking and paid landing pages — are being completed this month to support a cleaner relaunch. You should expect paid lead flow to resume in the next reporting period as those items come online.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all delivered in the first 17 days via Meta
cost per lead on Meta — the channel that produced every conversion this period
week-over-week increase in Google Business Profile actions, led by direction requests
